title: Shift Operations
learningObjectives: Identify the operators, operands and result types involved.
Predict an expression's result by tracing it.
Use the topic in a focused program.
Avoid common mistakes and choose a clear alternative.

understand.concept: << and >> shift bits. Avoid negative shift counts and counts at least the promoted operand width; use unsigned operands for bit-level operations.
understand.whyItMatters: Accurate expression understanding prevents logic errors and improves safety, readability and maintainability.
understand.explain: Study shift operations through the rule summary and examples; trace values carefully and note type and edge-case constraints.
